item.title: "My whole balance got wiped": Arknight Endfield halts Paypal payments after players were charged for transactions they didn't make
item.description: Arknights: Endfield, a new gacha action game released today, has temporarily halted PayPal transactions after multiple players were charged real money for in-game purchases they didn't make. Read more

item.title: Are smaller "one-sitting" games the way to go? Sorrowful archive-scouring game TR-49 sees Inkle's best launch ever
item.description: Creepy archive-searching deduction game TR-49 has had the best launch of any of Inkle's many games, the studio revealed today, meaning it sold better than games like Heaven's Vault and A Highland Song, which took longer and far more resources to make. Read more

item.title: Will Fable steal the show at tonight's Xbox Developer Direct? Join us here to discuss everything announced, as it happens
item.description: Tonight is the night when - after what has felt like months and months of waiting - we will finally get another look at Playground Games' Fable, thanks to the upcoming Xbox Developer Direct. Read more

item.title: A Steam Fest every 2.4 weeks: there are 22 planned for 2026
item.description: Valve has announced that Steam will feature 22 themed fests in 2026, coming in at around a different video game festival promotion every 2.4 weeks. Read more

item.title: Metroid Prime series producer Kensuke Tanabe is reportedly retiring after four decades at Nintendo
item.description: Veteran Nintendo producer Kensuke Tanabe, perhaps best known for his work overseeing the long-running Metroid Prime series, is reportedly retiring after almost four decades with the company. Read more

item.title: Xbox Developer Direct 2026: Everything announced
item.description: The Xbox Developer Direct has returned for 2026! While Microsoft kindly gave us all an early heads up on some of the games appearing - Fable (finally!), Forza Horizon 6 and Beast of Reincarnation. The showcase has given us an excellent look at the gameplay for each game and the new features you can expect to enjoy in returning titles like Forza Horizon 6. Like any good showcase, there was a nice surprise too! Read more

item.title: Beast of Reincarnation gets Summer 2026 release window and gameplay breakdown at Xbox Developer Direct
item.description: Beast of Reincarnation got a new gameplay presentation at the Xbox Developer Direct, as well as a Summer 2026 release window Read more

item.title: Forza Horizon 6 shows off the series' "largest" ever map as Microsoft confirms a May release and a PS5 launch later this year
item.description: It's a big day for Xbox fans, with Microsoft finally offering a closer look at some of its most anticipated titles, courtesy of its first Developer Direct of the year. And that began with a fresh peek at Forza Horizon 6, bringing word of a 19th May release date on PC and Xbox, with a PS5 launch coming later this year. Read more

item.title: Fable finally gets a release window following Xbox Developer Direct, will launch in Autumn 2026
item.description: A release window for Fable has just been announced at the Xbox Developer Direct. Read more

item.title: Psychonauts studio's latest oddity is pottery themed party brawler Kiln, and it's coming to Xbox, PS5, and PC
item.description: You can always count on Pyschonauts studio Double Fine to do something unexpected, and hot off last year's magical lighthouse adventure Keeper, the team has unveiled its latest oddity, Kiln: a pottery themed party brawler making its way to Xbox Series X/S, PC, Game Pass, and PS5 this "spring". Read more
